THE GIRL BEHIND THE HAIR

Hey, I’m Halli.

I’m Halli Miller, a hairstylist at The Hair Studio Salon & Spa in Logan, Utah. I’m from a small town in Washington, but Utah feels like my second home. I trained at Paul Mitchell in Logan, and I love all things hair — especially foil work!

Outside the salon, you’ll find me crafting, shopping, or trying something new — whether that’s a new restaurant around the corner or a fun little hike. I love helping people find a look they feel great in, and I can’t wait to see you in my chair!

BEFORE YOUR VISIT

The little details.

How do I book an appointment?+

Use the booking link to visit The Hair Studio Salon & Spa on Vagaro and select Halli as your stylist. You can also message @hairby.hallij on Instagram for help choosing a service.

What if I’m not sure which color service I need?+

Send Halli a message on Instagram with a photo of your current hair and your inspiration. She can help you decide where to start.

How much will my color appointment cost?+

Listed color prices are starting prices. The final price depends on your starting color, goals, hair length and density, and product needed. A personalized quote is discussed before your service begins.

Can I book an extension consultation?+

Yes! Extension consultations are free. Installation, move-ups, removal, and hair are quoted based on your needs. Message Halli to get started.
